---
title: "Utilities"
---

Standalone command-line utilities installed with Nexus.

| Command | Description |
|:--------|:------------|
| [nexus_calculate_cancer_cell_fraction](calculate_cancer_cell_fraction.qmd) | Calculate cancer cell fraction (CCF) for somatic DNA variants. |
| [nexus_convert_netmhcpan_txt2tsv](convert_netmhcpan_txt2tsv.qmd) | Convert NetMHCpan TXT output file to a TSV file. |
| [nexus_create_abra2_targets_bed_file](create_abra2_targets_bed_file.qmd) | Create an ABRA2 targets BED file based on a GENCODE GTF file. |
| [nexus_create_beers2_input_data](create_beers2_input_data.qmd) | Create Beers2 input data. |
| [nexus_filter_rnabloom2_transcripts](filter_rnabloom2_transcripts.qmd) | Filter RNA-Bloom2 assembled transcripts. |
| [nexus_scrna_convert_bam2fastq](scrna_convert_bam2fastq.qmd) | Convert an unaligned BAM file to a FASTQ. |
| [nexus_scrna_count_assembly_support](scrna_count_assembly_support.qmd) | Count cell and molecule support for each assembled transcript from scRNA-seq. |
| [nexus_scrna_filter_assembly](scrna_filter_assembly.qmd) | Filter scRNA-seq assembly based on minimum cell and molecule support. |
| [nexus_scrna_find_barcode_knee](scrna_find_barcode_knee.qmd) | Find the knee of the barcode rank plot from an unaligned scRNA-seq BAM file. |
| [nexus_split_fastq_by_hp_tag](split_fastq_by_hp_tag.qmd) | Split a fastq. |
